p: blessed Noah and his sons: God increased them with fruit, and declared to them his counsel as concerning the replenishing of the earth.
fear of you and the dread: By the virtue of this commandment, beasts do not rage as much against man as they would, yea and many serve his purposes by it.
moving thing that liveth shall be: By this permission man may with a good conscience use the creatures of God for his needs.
But flesh with the life thereof: That is, living creatures, and the flesh of beasts that are strangled: and by this all cruelty is forbidden.
And surely your blood of your: That is, I will take vengeance for your blood.
by man shall his blood be: Not only by the magistrate, but often God raises up one murderer to kill another.
image of God made he man: Therefore to kill man is to deface God's image, and so injury is not only done to man, but also to God.
covenant with you: To assure you that the world will never again be destroyed by a flood.
seed after you: The children which are not yet born, are comprehended in God's covenant with their fathers.
bow in the cloud: By this we see that signs or ordinances should not be separate from the word.
covenant: When men see my bow in the sky, they will know that I have not forgotten my covenant with them.
This is the token of the: God repeats this often to confirm Noah's faith even more.
overspread: This declares what the virtue of God's blessing was, when he said, increase and bring forth in Ge 1:28.
drunken: This is set before us to show what a horrible thing drunkenness is.
Canaan: Of whom came the Canaanites that wicked nation, who were also cursed by God.
told his two brethren without: In derision and contempt of his father.
Cursed be Canaan: He pronounces as a prophet the curse of God against all those who do not honour their parents: for Ham and his posterity were cursed.
servant of servants shall he be: That is, a most vile slave.
enlarge Japheth: He declares that the Gentiles, who came from Japheth, and were separated from the Church, should be joined to the same by the persuasion of God's Spirit, and preaching of the gospel.
